description: Hanford Tank Waste Operations and Closure, LLC (H2C) as a prime contractor to the U.S. Department of Energy is issuing this Request for Expression of Interest (EOI) as a means of conducting market research to identify Small Business Enterprises having an interest in and the resources to provide subsurface investigations (ground scanning) services (NAICS Code 541360) on the Hanford Site. Specific locations will be defined in each service request issued under this blanket master agreement.
